title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
summary: Pick one day to buy and a later day to sell so that the profit is as large as possible.

tests.explain: Buy at index 3 (price 1) and sell at index 4 (price 7): a profit of 6.
Prices only fall, so every trade loses money. Not trading gives 0.
The lowest price, 1, comes too late: selling after it earns at most 5 - 1 = 4. Buying at 2 and selling at 9 earns 7.

hints: Checking every buy day against every later sell day is O(n²). Fix the sell day instead: which buy day is best for it?
For a sell on day i, the best buy is the cheapest price on any day before i. Keep that minimum as you scan.
One pass: profit = max(profit, price - minSoFar), then minSoFar = min(minSoFar, price). Start profit at 0, so not trading is allowed.
